slices.focus: Father moves to senior apartment closer to Lucia and Daniel
slices.summary: After another winter wobble and a blunt doctor's conversation about mobility, Lucia's father Rogelio agrees to move from living alone on the West Side into a small senior apartment closer to Lucia and Daniel. The move reduces the driving chaos but maintains the responsibility — shifting from emergency transport to ongoing oversight. Lucia works to separate tasks into urgent/legal/sentimental categories, designs one folder system (physical + digital) with practical tabs (identification, lease, medical, medications, appointments, transportation), and plans a 'who-handles-what' list with her father to preserve his autonomy. She also creates different visit types (practical visits vs. coffee-and-sitting visits) to keep grief from hijacking logistics, and protects two evenings a week from automatic drop-ins.
